# Pulse button — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for `PulseButton` when an interface demands a locked, unshifting corner silhouette (`pill`, `rounded`, or `square`) while still delivering rich Material 3 Expressive spring feedback. Where `Button` morphs its corner radius toward square on press and toggle selection, `PulseButton` keeps `border-radius` invariant across every state and channels energy into a spring scale pulse (`--sys-motion-spring-fast-spatial`), a radial state-layer bloom (`[data-slot="pulse-bloom"]`), and a subtle kinetic icon nudge. Both components share the exact same color, emphasis, and size token tables via `button-shared.ts`, so switching between shape-morphing and shape-stable buttons is a one-word import change with zero visual drift at rest.

### Usage

**Do**

- Use `PulseButton` in dense toolbars, table rows, and financial or operational surfaces where corner-radius morphing on adjacent controls feels visually noisy.
- Pair `PulseButton` with `ButtonGroup` when you want joined segments whose outer and inner radii stay locked during rapid clicking.
- Wire `onHaptic` to platform haptic feedback on mobile/touch web when triggering high-consequence actions.
- Use the same `variant`, `color`, `size`, and `shape` props as `Button` — the two share a single style engine.

**Don't**

- Don't use `toggle` with `variant="text"` — M3 defines no toggle text treatment.
- Don't override `transform` with static transitions that strip the `--sys-motion-spring-fast-spatial` spring curve; let `motion-reduce:` handle reduced-motion preferences automatically.

### Tokens

| Element | State | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Container scale | resting | comp.button.container.shape | locked (no press/toggle corner morph) |
| Container scale | hover | sys.motion.spring.fast-spatial | scale(1.015) |
| Radial bloom | focus | sys.state.focus-state-layer-opacity | 10% |
| Container scale & bloom | focus / pressed | sys.motion.spring.fast-spatial | scale(0.97) + radial bloom |
| Disabled container | disabled | comp.button.disabled.container.opacity | on-surface 12% |

## Native

### Features

On React Native, `PulseButton` wraps the shared `buttonStyles` engine (`morphCorners: false`) inside an `Animated.View` driven by `buttonSpringConfig("pressIn" | "pressOut")` from `@xoroh/kern-tokens`. Pressing compresses the control to `0.97` with M3's `fast-spatial` spring (`stiffness: 1400, damping: 67.3`) and releases back to `1.0` with `default-spatial` (`stiffness: 700, damping: 47.6`), while the container's `borderRadius` and `StateLayer` radius remain locked.

### Tokens

| Element | State | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Container | resting | comp.button.container.shape | locked borderRadius |
| Animated.View scale | pressed | sys.motion.spring.fast-spatial | scale(0.97), stiffness 1400, damping 67.3 |
